title: Stash Invite WIP for the TTL Hotfix
description:
**SITUATION:**

Forgeboard is adding **workspace invites** so enterprise admins can bring teammates into a workspace with a link. You are on `feature/workspace-invites` in `~/sprint-service` building that feature. That branch already has committed invite work ahead of `main` — several commits that belong only on the feature, not on a hotfix.

On top of those commits you also have an **uncommitted** edit in `src/main.py`: a preview banner for pending invite counts. The banner is half-finished — dirty in your working tree, not ready to commit. Keep it off every branch tip for now.

Ops needs invite links on staging to last 72 hours. On `main`, `invite_link_ttl_hours` is still 0 under `[invites]`, so enterprise admins cannot get teammates into Forgeboard before the walkthrough. Jordan asked you to open a short fix branch **from today's `main`** (not from the feature), set only that TTL to 72, and push the fix for review. The fix branch should carry exactly one new commit beyond `main` — the config change — and must not include the feature's invite commits or the banner WIP. Do not change `main` yourself.

Git will not let you switch away with those dirty edits in the way. Set the WIP aside, land and push the fix from `main`, then come back to the feature and put your banner edit back exactly as it was.

Your identity (Ada Learner) is already configured. Start on `feature/workspace-invites` in `~/sprint-service`; `origin` already points at the team forge.

**YOUR TASK:**

1. Set aside your uncommitted invite-banner edit so you can leave the feature branch (do not commit it).
2. Switch to `main`, open `fix/invite-ttl-72` from that tip, set `invite_link_ttl_hours` to 72, and commit only that config change. Push the fix for review. Do not push or update `main`, and do not base the fix on `feature/workspace-invites`.
3. Switch back to `feature/workspace-invites`, restore your banner edit exactly as it was, and end with that WIP as the only dirty change (nothing left set aside).

hints: git stash push -m "invite banner WIP" sets the dirty src/main.py aside — do not commit it.
git switch main && git switch -c fix/invite-ttl-72 — must branch from main, not from the feature.
Edit only invite_link_ttl_hours to 72, commit, push. The fix tip should be exactly one commit beyond main and touch only config/app.conf.
git switch feature/workspace-invites && git stash pop — restore the banner. Leave main alone.
problemStatement.overview: Feature already has commits ahead of `main` plus dirty banner WIP. Set WIP aside, land exactly one TTL=72 commit on `fix/invite-ttl-72` from `main`, push, restore WIP.
problemStatement.brief: Stash WIP. From main, one-commit `fix/invite-ttl-72` (TTL 72 only), push. Restore WIP on the feature. Leave `main` alone.
problemStatement.solution:
# Solution — Stash Invite WIP for the TTL Hotfix

Dirty invite-banner WIP blocks switching off `feature/workspace-invites`. Stash it, land `fix/invite-ttl-72` from `main`, push for review, then restore the WIP.

## 1. Stash the WIP

```bash
cd ~/sprint-service
git status
git stash push -m "invite banner wip"
git status
```

## 2. Fix branch from main

```bash
git switch main
git switch -c fix/invite-ttl-72
nano config/app.conf   # invite_link_ttl_hours = 72
git add config/app.conf
git commit -m "Set invite link TTL to 72 hours"
git push -u origin fix/invite-ttl-72
```

## 3. Restore the feature WIP

```bash
git switch feature/workspace-invites
git stash pop
git stash list          # empty
git status              # M src/main.py
```

Leave `main` where you found it.
